inline_text:
## Outcome

Tested relationships connecting model calls, approval decisions, tool execution, and independently observed effects.

Task 6 of the nine-task Agent Behavior Trace Model execution plan following the August WG discussions.

**Why:** Session membership does not explain which work caused a call, which action was approved, or what changed outside the agent.

**Work and examples:**

- **Calls and retries:** a visible model-call attempt fails and another succeeds while handling the ticket request. Associate both with the triggering work and count reported usage once. Unavailable usage and hidden retries remain unknown.
- **Approvals:** “Approve” must refer to proposed action P1. A denial should not produce a fictional tool execution.
- **Effects:** the agent observes tool execution E1; the service separately reports creating ticket-42. Preserve the correlation that connects the receipt to E1 and P1.

## Acceptance Criteria

**Done when:** tests cover all three relationships and report each example's coverage. Missing confirmation remains unknown; observed approval is not proof of enforcement. These pieces can be assigned separately.

## Tracking

- **Workstream:** Agent Behavior Trace Model
- **Owner:** needs owner
- **Status:** needs owner
- **Next step:** Find contributors and reviewers for the three pieces of work and record each example's supported capabilities.
- **Depends on:** [Task 4](https://github.com/aaif/wg-observability-and-traceability/issues/42) and [Task 5](https://github.com/aaif/wg-observability-and-traceability/issues/43).
